known.title: The 2 new #100 cases cannot show the benchmark harness that the #100 plan changes, because every plan snapshot leaves out the whole review-benchmark folder
known.locator: Research, New plan cases (line 34); Steps, row 2 plan_cases (line 69)
known.summary: At repo_ref, prepare.mjs builds every plan snapshot and diff with hiddenPathspec and checkoutSnapshot (.agents/skills/review-benchmark/scripts/prepare.mjs, lines 551-596), and both leave out all of .agents/skills/review-benchmark/; the skill's Workspace section says the same. #100 is the plan that changes that folder (results.md, Leads from #98 and Corpus (plan #100 step 7)). So a reviewer of a #100 case finds no prepare.mjs, score.mjs, or skill text under snapshot/ to check the plan's claims, and a read of the live copy is outside the read scope and makes the run invalid. A known defect whose evidence is in the harness then cannot be found, and arms that check more claims lose more runs, so the new cases bias the comparison. The plan must count the known defects that need that folder, or show the folder without cases/ in such a snapshot.

known.title: One held-out report over the 14 #100 cases and the 2 new cases cannot be made, because score.mjs reads every key from the keys folder when --keys is given
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 4 (line 45) and decision 6 (line 47); Steps, row 5 heldout_runs (line 72)
known.summary: score.mjs readKnown (.agents/skills/review-benchmark/scripts/score.mjs, lines 436-443 at repo_ref) reads only <keys>/<id>.key.json for each case without inline known when --keys is given, and only the key next to the case file without --keys; a missing key stops it with '... is missing and ... has no known defects'. The skill's Cases section says the same ('never the key file next to the case file'). The 14 #100 keys are in cases/heldout/, and decision 6 keeps the 2 new keys outside the repository. So pairs with --keys stops at the first #100 case, and pairs without --keys stops at a new case, while decision 5 needs one report whose intervals cover all 16 cases. Step 5 must copy the 14 published plan keys into the keys folder before pairs and report.

known.title: For a V16 win, the shipped files cannot equal the winner's ref, so step 6 Done when and a5 fail in a case that decision 5 allows
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 5 (line 46); Steps, row 6 ship_prompt, Done when (line 73); Acceptance, a5 (line 85)
known.summary: Decision 5 says a V16 win ships the 0.16.0 text with the 0.17.1 delta mode added, and decision 2 marks V16 (plan-lifecycle--v0.16.0) as full only, without a delta mode. Step 6 Done when requires that the shipped files equal the winner's files, and a5 runs git diff <winner ref> HEAD on the plan-reviewer files and expects no output. For a V16 win, the diff then prints the added delta mode, so both checks fail. Step 6 must commit the shipped combination on a named local ref, and step 6 and a5 must compare with that ref.

known.title: Candidates A, B, and C are measured with the unchanged contract sentence that a recorded decision is settled, which undoes candidate A on yolo plans, and then ship with a changed sentence
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 1 A (line 39) and decision 7 (line 48); Steps, row 3 candidates, Files (line 70)
known.summary: Decision 2 exports each variant's whole plugins/plan-lifecycle, and the reviewer reads plan-manager/references/plan-contract.md of its own plugin. On the candidate refs from main, the contract still says 'Reviewers treat a recorded decision as settled.' (plan-contract.md line 585 at repo_ref, Yolo runs). Under candidate A's own precedence, the contract ranks above the plan, so Va, Vb, and Vc run with a rule that undoes A on yolo plans, also on the dev cases where decision 4 expects A to find more. Decision 7 changes that sentence only at shipping, so the shipped prompt differs from the measured prompt in the rule that A targets. The contract change must be part of candidate A (and B and C) on the step 3 refs, with plan-contract.md in the step 3 Files cell and in the a5 comparison.

known.title: The step that changes plan-contract.md does not name plan-manager/SKILL.md, whose content_hash and updated fields the required backfill rewrites
known.summary: scripts/skills/content-hash.mjs (lines 4-5 and 11 at repo_ref) hashes a skill's SKILL.md body plus its sorted references/*.md, and --backfill re-syncs content_hash and stamps updated. plan-contract.md is a reference of plan-manager, so a change to it makes the backfill that plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/AGENTS.md (line 25) requires rewrite content_hash and metadata.updated in plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/SKILL.md (lines 7-8). No Files cell names that file. Without it, the gate's content-hash.mjs --check-only and the idempotency test fail.

known.title: The candidate refs are committed without the selected-plugin gate that the root AGENTS.md requires, so a failing agent score shows up only at shipping
known.locator: Steps, row 3 candidates, Done when (line 70); Steps, row 6 ship_prompt, Done when (line 73); Acceptance, a1, a5, a6 (lines 81, 85, 86)
known.summary: The root AGENTS.md (line 98 at repo_ref) requires bun scripts/ci.mjs --plugin <name> before committing a change owned by one plugin. Step 3 commits plan-lifecycle changes on the candidate refs, and step 4 can revise one, without this gate. Step 6 needs both the measured files unchanged (a5) and a green gate (a1, a6). Each agent file must score at least 14 (scripts/config/scoring.json, agents.per_file_floor) on the 15-point rubric of scripts/agents/score.mjs. So a winning agent text that loses one point fails the gate only after the held-out runs, and step 6 must then ship unmeasured text (a5 fails) or ship with a red gate. Step 3 and the step 4 revision must run the plan-lifecycle gate on each ref.
